description:
Vintage Estate Tobacco Pipes
Briar Smoking Pipe Collection
9 Items, Mid to Late 20th Century
This estate lot includes nine vintage briar tobacco smoking pipes presenting a diverse selection of classic English and American shapes, finishes, and makers. The collection features smooth, carved, rusticated, and sandblast bowls across various traditional silhouettes including straight billiards, bent apples, bulldogs, and unique carved freehand forms.

1.
Shamrock Briar Pipe

4.
Senator Bent Apple Pipe

5.

7.
Carved Fluted Panel Pipe
- Freehand style with deep carved vertical fluting and black stem

Scot Rusticated Billiard Pipe
- Dark sandblast/rusticated finish, stem stamped "SCOT"
9.
Scotsman's Delight Billiard Pipe
- Black rusticated bowl stamped "SCOTSMAN'S DELIGHT MADE IN ENGLAND"

Pre-owned vintage estate condition. Bowls show carbon cake and charring consistent with prior use. Stems exhibit varying degrees of oxidation, tooth chatter, and cosmetic wear. All tenons and stems fit securely into shanks with no breaks visible.

Description:
Add a unique piece of history to your space with this assortment of vintage teal glass insulators, once used to support overhead power lines. Each insulator in this set showcases distinct shapes, textures, and slightly different shades of teal and green, creating a captivating collection for display. Visible wear and patina reflect their authentic utility and age, enhancing their nostalgic character and appeal. One notable feature is a wooden base with a descriptive label, indicating these insulators were part of the Colorado Springs - Cripple Creek Toll Line, dated from 1910 to 1978. This historical detail adds an extra layer of interest, making the set especially attractive for collectors and history enthusiasts. Ideal for use as decorative accents on shelves, mantels, or desks, these insulators offer a charming way to incorporate industrial heritage into your home or office decor. This item is in used vintage condition and displays signs of wear consistent with age and previous use

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. Description
: Discover an intriguing assortment of rocks, minerals, and shells housed in a handy compartmentalized plastic case. This set includes vibrant mineral clusters, raw geode pieces, and polished as well as natural shells. Notable is a shell decorated with a Sagittarius motif, adding a unique astrological touch to the collection. The selection showcases various colors, textures, and forms, making it ideal for enthusiasts, educational purposes, or display. The case itself is sturdy and features secure yellow clasps, ensuring safe storage and portability. Each specimen is distinct, providing a firsthand look at nature's variety and beauty. The set appears to be in used, clean condition with all pieces intact as shown in the images. Case measures approximately 13 inches in length. Perfect for beginner collectors, students, or as a gift for anyone interested in geology and natural history. Please review all photographs to see the exact items included and current condition

description:
This lot includes three vintage electrical insulators from Whitall Tatum Co. and Hemingray, prominent American manufacturers. The insulators are made of glass in aqua and green shades and feature black ceramic parts. They show signs of age such as surface dirt and minor scuffing but have no major cracks or breaks. The bottoms display detailed beading and threading typical of older insulator designs. Suitable for collectors of antique electrical equipment or industrial decor.

Scott's Mineral Box Industries
Vintage Rocks and Minerals Specimen Collection Set
24 Labeled Specimens with Display Box
A classic mid-century educational geology collection produced by Scott's Mineral Box Industries of Custer, South Dakota. Dating to the 1950s to 1960s, these boxed study sets were distributed to rockhounds, students, and tourists visiting the Black Hills. Each natural geological specimen is mounted and identified on a printed compartmentalized tray, illustrating key ore, mineral, and rock classifications from North American deposits.
Includes 24 individually labeled specimens including Gold Ore, Copper Ore, Rose Quartz, Muscovite, Uranium Ore, and Petrified Wood
Accompanied by an additional natural clear quartz crystal point
Housed in the original faux-tooled leatherette textured cardboard box with matching lid
Measures approximately 8.6 inches long by 5.6 inches wide by 1 inch deep
Condition:
Box lid and base remain structurally sound with light corner and edge wear consistent with age. Printed tray is clean and legible with all 24 labeled specimens intact and firmly attached. Loose quartz crystal point is complete with natural terminations and surface inclusions.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Natural Petrified Wood Specimen
Agatized Fossilized Wood Display
Natural Mineral Fossil, 10.4 Inches, 2.9 lbs
Substantial natural petrified wood specimen exhibiting well-preserved exterior bark texture alongside a richly silicified interior. Petrified wood forms through permineralization, in which organic plant tissue is buried under sediment and gradually replaced by silica minerals such as chalcedony and agate over millions of years. This freestanding piece displays a varied palette of honey amber, cream, earthy brown, and dark charcoal tones, making it an impressive display piece for fossil and mineral collectors.
Silicified fossil wood with distinct exterior bark and longitudinal grain structure
Polished and natural mineralized faces with chalcedony and agate formations
Cut flat base allowing the specimen to sit upright unsupported for tabletop or shelf display
Measures 10.4 inches long by 6.4 inches wide by 3.8 inches high; weighs approximately 2.9 pounds
Condition:
Natural geological specimen in very good display condition. Features expected natural fissures, crevices, and conchoidal fractures typical of agatized wood. Flat cut base is level and stable. No synthetic coatings, glue, or modern repairs detected.

-All items are from the same Goodwill seller
-Customer has NOT paid for any of the items
-The actual weight of the combined items is LESS than 20 pounds

PICKUP:
Local pickup appointments must be scheduled at least 24 hours in advance. Pickup is available Monday, Wednesday, Friday from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM. All orders must be paid in full prior to pickup. Once Auctions are won, they are easily and securely paid for using PayPal or Stripe. All Major credit cards are accepted. We cannot accept cash, checks, money orders, or Bitcoin. All sales will include state sales tax on all orders, which is calculated using the total of the purchase price, handling, and shipping charges.
Shipping FedEx:

The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a PO Box. Combined Shipping:
Items may be combined to save on shipping charges if the auctions close within 7 days of each other and are safe to ship in one box. Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, not additional items may be added to an order.

We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

description:
Natural Amethyst Quartz Crystal Lot - 2 Pieces
Polished Edge Geode Slab & Cylindrical Core Specimen
Natural Mineral, 2.38 lbs Total
This two-piece mineral specimen lot features an authentic amethyst geode cluster slab and an amethyst core cylinder. The primary display plate showcases a rich purple crystal druzy cavity framed by a polished blue-grey agate banding border with an intact natural matrix base. Accompanying the geode plate is a solid drilled core cylinder terminating in natural crystalline points with distinct zoning and phantom inclusions.
Items Included:
Amethyst Geode Cluster Slab: Displays deep violet terminations bordered by polished chalcedony agate; measures approximately 6.5 x 5.5 inches with a thickness of roughly 2.25 inches
Amethyst Core Cylinder: Features polished cylindrical sides and rough terminated top; measures approximately 3.5 inches in height and 37.4 mm (1.47 inches) in diameter
Combined Weight: 2.38 lbs (1.08 kg)
Condition:
Both mineral specimens are in excellent natural condition. Terminations within the geode cluster are clean and sharply formed with vibrant purple saturation. The polished edges along the slab and cylinder perimeter are smooth. Inherent internal veining, micro-fractures, and mineral inclusions are natural characteristics of mined quartz.

How Photography Affects Size Perception
Macro (extreme close-up) photography is heavily utilized in jewelry listings, enabling viewers to examine pieces in larger-than-life detail. About Gemstone & Metal Testing
Gemstones are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester. Goodwill of the Olympics & Rainier Region is a member of the International Gem Society; however, as we are not certified gemologists, we cannot guarantee the authenticity of any gemstone unless otherwise stated. Gemstone identification information is provided for your reference and consideration in bidding; no guarantee is implied.
Pearls are tested with a check for grittiness to detect nacre irregularities. We are generally unable to specify pearl types and characteristics; they may be cultured, wild, freshwater or saltwater pearls. Coral may be natural or dyed; most of our coral listings include dyed pieces.
Metals including Gold, Silver, and Platinum are tested using an XRF precious metal analyzer, the Niton XL2 by Thermo Scientific, unless explicitly noted otherwise. XRF (X-ray fluorescence) analysis is a non-destructive testing method able to determine an item's elemental composition. Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. Some jewelry may contain non-precious metals in clasps or findings, causing parts of the piece to respond to a magnet.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
